summary: When LIKE isn't enough, GLOB adds case sensitivity and REGEXP adds full patterns.
points: GLOB is case-sensitive and uses * for any text, ? for one character, and [a-z] for a range.
REGEXP matches a regular expression. In this app, it uses JavaScript's rules.
^ means the start and $ means the end. Without them, a pattern can match part of the text.
\. means a real dot, because a plain . matches any character. + means one or more.

example.explanation: This requires a letter first, then allowed characters, then exactly @club.test at the end.
